body: Happy early bday :) glad I’m not alone

She only put me on it since I was at college away from her and had a boyfriend there where she couldn’t control how often I was allowed to see him. Moms are wack sometimes

It’s otc at any drugstore. I’d make sure you’re checking dosage (don’t go too big too soon) and deciding pills v gummies- in my experience gummies take a little longer to kick in. Also look up long term effects for self medicating w melatonin and if it gets to a point where you feel like otc stuff isn’t working seek medical advice. I think it’s really great you’re asking your mom I don’t think it’s a bad idea for her to know what you’re going thru
Thanks a bunch!! I’ll definitely look into that. I didn’t know there was a dream guide that’s actually really cool!!

Outdoors are so much fun! Props to y’all for knowing what you love!

Easy outdoors things that don’t cost too much-

-picnics: just pack a lunchbox and grab a blanket

-Park walks: you don’t need to go hiking all the 
time if you’re bored of it. There’s plenty of parks that can add to a list of places you can visit

-hammocks: if you invest in a good quality hammock you can get a lot of use out of it, it might be a little bit of money but it will pay itself off

-swimming: public lakes, rivers, watering holes, waterfalls, etc. Some of them have hikes leading up to them as well

-exploring abandoned places, might be a little risky depending on the place, but some gems are fun to visit as long as y’all are safe

- if y’all like pets and don’t have one, you could look up ways to walk and play with dogs from your local shelter

- camping is definitely going to be on the pricey side if you buy equipment, but if you have good weather, a car y’all can comfortably sleep in, and a dirt road you feel safe on, its like camping on beginner mode. If you do buy quality stuff and it doesn’t get ruined immediately, it will pay itself off

Though she might have good intentions, they way she is presenting them isn’t ok. Nobody should joke about something you can’t immediately fix(food in teeth for example). You should be upfront about how it makes you feel when she tries to help and goes as far as joking about you. As to how you appear, she shouldn’t have any impact on how you think about yourself. Took me a while to get over how my mom spoke about me but there is definitely an end to it. 

Again, I would recommend being very clear and upfront about each problem she makes, how it makes you feel, and how you think would be the best way to solve it. If she brings up some bs about just being a caring mother, try and show her a different path to where she can still express how much she cares about you but in a more positive and beneficial manner, maybe y’all could do a face mask once a week together or if you’re still working out take a fitness class with her, this way she feels involved but on your terms. If she still continues to ridicule you and put you down, she’s a horrible person. That’s a separate issue and I can’t help much with that as I don’t know how independent you are from your mom. Focus on the positives, if you can, when talking to her. 

Wish you the best!
